title: Extended-Supply Multipliers and Protected Product Terms across the Ridgecrest RxSecure Plans
content:
Each Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan carries two extended-supply multipliers and three protected-product terms. The multipliers are the decimal figures the plan carries for a 90-day fill, one for a fill by mail order and one for a fill at retail, each expressed against the plan's 30-day preferred retail cost share. The protected-product terms are the insulin cap, the member cost of a recommended adult vaccine and the largest days supply a long-term care pharmacy may dispense at once.

| Plan | Mail-order 90-day multiplier | Retail 90-day multiplier | Largest days supply a long-term care pharmacy may dispense at once | Insulin cost cap for a one-month supply (USD) | Member cost for a recommended adult vaccine (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 3.0 | 3.0 | 31 | 35.0 | 0.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 2.5 | 3.0 | 31 | 35.0 | 0.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 2.5 | 3.0 | 31 | 35.0 | 0.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 2.0 | 2.5 | 31 | 35.0 | 0.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 2.0 | 2.5 | 31 | 35.0 | 0.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 2.0 | 2.5 | 31 | 35.0 | 0.0 |

## Reading the schedule

The two multipliers are scheduled separately because they do not agree on every plan. They stand together at 3.0 on Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) and together at 2.5 on Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP), Complete (PDP) and Premier (PDP) for retail against 2.0 for mail order. They part company on Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) and Select (PDP), where mail order is scheduled at 2.5 and 90-day retail at 3.0. Across the range the mail-order multiplier falls from 3.0 to 2.0 and the retail multiplier from 3.0 to 2.5.

## Terms that do not move with the plan

The long-term care dispensing limit of 31 days supply, the insulin cap of 35.0 USD for a one-month supply, and the member cost of 0.0 USD for an adult vaccine recommended by the immunisation schedule are written at the same figures on all six Ridgecrest RxSecure plans.
